errors.description: queue_entry_q is a multi-bit value produced in host_clk and sampled directly in accel_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
enqueue_pulse_q is a one-cycle host_clk pulse consumed directly in accel_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
enqueue_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample accel_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in accel_event_o.
op_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector op_mode_q before decoding in accel_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
host_rst_n is used as data inside accel_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
dma_snapshot_q combines host_clk payload state with accel_clk status state in dma_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
